visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a white pot containing a steaming, colorful soup with cauliflower, cabbage, and seared chicken wings. A wooden spoon is used to scoop and pour the golden broth back into the pot, highlighting its texture. The background shows a cozy, warmly lit kitchen with a lantern and shelves. (2) A person's hands are seen holding a metal tray of raw chicken wings. The person then uses a sharp knife to make precise cuts near the bone of the wings on a wooden cutting board to facilitate better seasoning absorption. (3) The chicken wings are placed in a stainless steel bowl where the hands sprinkle salt, pepper, and pour a clear liquid (cooking wine) over them, followed by thorough mixing. (4) The scene shifts to peeling white radishes and carrots over a tray, showing the smooth skin being removed in long strips. (5) Various vegetables including onions, radishes, carrots, ginger, and garlic are chopped into large chunks or slices on the wooden board. (6) A black frying pan is heated with oil, and the seasoned chicken wings are placed inside to sear until the skin turns a golden brown and crispy texture. (7) The chopped vegetables are layered at the bottom of the white pot, followed by the seared chicken wings, garlic, ginger, and fresh green herbs. Clear water and more wine are poured into the pot. (8) The pot is placed on a white IH electronic cooker, and the lid is closed. On-screen text indicates a 30-minute stewing period. (9) While the soup cooks, the hands prepare cauliflower, pumpkin, and cabbage by cutting them into bite-sized pieces. (10) The pot lid is opened, revealing the boiling soup; the herbs are removed, and pumpkin chunks are added for another 10 minutes of cooking. (11) In the final stage, cauliflower and cabbage are added to the boiling pot, and a final pinch of salt is sprinkled over the surface. (12) The video concludes with the finished soup being stirred and scooped, showing the tender ingredients and rich broth.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring a bright acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat. A soft splashing sound is heard as liquid is poured into a pot. (2) Rhythmic, percussive thuds occur as a knife hits a wooden cutting board, signaling the start of vegetable preparation. The BGM remains consistent and upbeat. (3) A distinct metallic scrape and click are heard as a peeler is used against a hard vegetable surface. (4) The audio texture shifts with a loud, sustained sizzling sound of oil frying chicken wings, masking some of the finer musical details temporarily. (5) Bubbling and boiling water sounds emerge, creating a wet, dense acoustic atmosphere as the soup simmers. (6) A short, digital 'beep' from the electronic cooker signals a stage completion, followed by more light chopping and stirring sounds. (7) The video concludes with the same upbeat acoustic BGM maintaining a positive, energetic vibe until the end.
